details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K4 and K6 are fully covered. K3 is only partially covered because LNG Terminal revenue is mentioned but Liquid Energy Terminals and commercial LNG activities are not explicitly broken out. K5 is only partially covered because cash increased but the slight reduction in borrowings is not stated. K7 is completely missing.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence builds logically on the previous one: revenue growth (S2) is explained by segment drivers (S3–S6), which in turn explain the gross-profit movement (S7–S8). Operating expenses (S9) and operating profit (S10) follow directly from the cost structure already described. Finance items (S12) and net-profit figures (S13–S14) are presented in a consistent sequence without contradictions. Cash-flow and balance-sheet movements (S15–S19) are presented chronologically and numerically consistent with the profit progression. No sentence negates or conflicts with another, and the narrative flows without repetition or structural gaps.
